stations.title: Idris
stations.say: When the count arrives, do this.

stations.title: The docket
stations.text: Knows when it settles. Nobody else does.

stations.title: Your then()
stations.gap: No way to say what to do

captions: Idris wants to say what happens when the paper count arrives, not guess when to look.
On a slow night the price list looked too early and printed pending for the card.
You write then(), which keeps callbacks until the docket settles, in three tasks.
Now the card count is printed the moment it arrives, however long that takes.
Every count is printed when it is ready, and nobody has to guess.
